blocks.text: Managing supplier communication in Outlook

Inventory management relies on clear, fast communication. You likely spend hours each day tracking purchase orders and delivery status. The new Outlook for Mac interface helps you stay organized if you know where to look. Microsoft now requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later for the latest updates. Keep your app updated to ensure you have the latest performance fixes.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for inventory managers

Speed is critical when you have hundreds of emails to process. Use these shortcuts to save time every day. Press ⌘ + 1 to switch to your Mail view. Press ⌘ + 2 to jump to your Calendar. Press ⌘ + N to start a new email to a supplier. Press ⌘ + S to save a draft if you need to verify stock before sending. Press ⌘ + Return to send your message instantly.
Organizing your inbox with rules

You can automate your workflow by creating rules for incoming messages. If all emails from a specific warehouse arrive with the same subject line, use a rule to move them into a dedicated folder. Go to Settings > Rules to set this up. This keeps your main inbox clean for urgent requests. It prevents important supplier updates from getting lost in a pile of general notifications.
If you struggle to find a setting, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where it is. Lazur will draw a circle around the menu item for you.
blocks.title: Find settings faster

blocks.text: The transition from legacy Outlook

Microsoft is retiring legacy Outlook for Mac. You should move to the new version now. You can toggle this from the Outlook menu in the top bar. Note that some features like advanced OLM file imports are different in the new version. Check your account settings to ensure your exchange server syncs correctly. If you see connection errors like -3253, restart the app or check your network.
Faster with Lazur

Lazur helps you handle the administrative load of inventory management. You can use it to dictate notes while you check stock levels. It also helps you find specific emails or settings without searching through menus. Hold the fn key to dictate text directly into your email body. This is faster than typing when you are in a hurry.
Handling email interruptions

Inventory managers often face constant email interruptions. Research shows it takes over 23 minutes to regain focus after an interruption. Try to batch your email processing. Check your inbox at specific times during the day. Use the pin feature to keep urgent tasks at the top. You can find out how to [pin an email in outlook](/how-to/pin-an-email-in-outlook) in our guide. This prevents important tasks from slipping through the cracks.
Managing shared mailboxes

Many inventory teams use shared mailboxes for order tracking. Adding these to your Mac is straightforward in the new Outlook. You can [add a shared mailbox in outlook](/how-to/add-a-shared-mailbox-in-outlook) using the account settings pane. Ensure you have the correct permissions from your IT team before you start. Once added, the mailbox appears in your sidebar automatically.
Search and filter for inventory data

Finding an old purchase order can take time. Use the search bar with specific filters. You can [search with filters in outlook](/how-to/search-with-filters-in-outlook) to narrow down results by sender, date, or subject. This is much faster than scrolling through thousands of messages. Combine this with keyboard navigation to find what you need in seconds.
Setting up automatic replies

When you are away from your desk, let your suppliers know. It is easy to [turn on automatic replies in outlook](/how-to/turn-on-automatic-replies-in-outlook) for your account. This manages expectations and prevents unnecessary follow-up emails. Keep your message clear and provide a point of contact if possible.
Customizing your workflow

Your workspace should fit your needs. You can [change the default font in outlook](/how-to/change-the-default-font-in-outlook) to make reading easier. You can also [create an email signature in outlook](/how-to/create-an-email-signature-in-outlook) to save time on every outgoing message. These small changes add up over a busy week of managing inventory.

If you find yourself doing the same task repeatedly, look for built-in tools. While Outlook for Mac does not have traditional Quick Steps, you can often use rules to achieve the same result. Learn how to [create a rule in outlook](/how-to/create-a-rule-in-outlook) to automate your most common sorting tasks. This keeps your focus on inventory rather than email management.

faq.question: How do I switch to the new Outlook for Mac?
faq.answer: Go to the Outlook menu in the top bar of your screen. Select New Outlook to toggle the interface. You can switch back to the legacy version from the same menu if needed.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to click buttons in Outlook?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons for you. You can ask Lazur where a button is, and it will draw a circle around it on your screen to help you find it.

faq.question: Why is my Outlook sync failing?
faq.answer: Sync issues often relate to network connectivity or server settings. Check your internet connection first. If the problem persists, verify your account settings in Outlook > Settings > Accounts.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with other apps on my Mac?
faq.answer: Yes, Lazur works in any app on your Mac. You can use it to dictate text or ask questions about what is on your screen in any application.
